parameters.rainTimeProvenance: Reconstructed from root-confirmed UI sequence: Fissa stato di confronto resets forcingTime0, then Pioggia/35ArrowUp, no Riprendi. Missing from original benchmark JSON.

camera.probeFlow: 16-cubed half-float CPU reference, filtered; dynamic dispersal/micro erosion omitted conservatively

parameters.cacheLayout: texel-centred RG16F(A,s), clamp-to-edge, ideal trilinear after independent per-node IEEE binary16 RNE
parameters.gateContributorDefinition: Original A>0; separate stricter original-or-candidate union gate. Unweighted p99/max; opacity-weighted mean additionally reported.

scope: One historical576-ray pose, original baseline governs trajectory/cutoff; both candidates evaluated on identical points only. Candidate T beyond a baseline opacity exit is censored; no actual candidate ray-path or timing claim. No rendering sourceRGB/pixel/photographic acceptance or native sampler qualification.
differencesFromWGSL: Explicit f32 wrapper for camera ray, jitter, interval clipping, t/ds, rain coordinates and transmittance; no model of FMA/reassociation/allowed GPU transcendental error. Texture filters use ideal CPU bilinear/trilinear weights, then selected values rounded f32; Apple sampler precision differs as cycle9 audit showed.

Cloud reference uses shared referencePosition helper in JS number precision then rounds outputf32. Cloud material uses shared sampleCloudDensity helper and raw threshold; intermediate warp/erosion/pow operations are not rounded at every WGSL operation.
Flow is shared CPU analytic field packed half and sampled clamp, not actual GPU compute/readback. Half conversion/native trig may change thresholds.

Precipitation evaporation uses shared CPU precipitationSurvival then f32; other rain branches port shader formulas. Terrain retains original sea-gated six-pass algorithm, CPU terrainHeight; no solver correction.

Sky/lighting/aerial/tone/sourceRGB are omitted because they do not affect opacity termination. Their conditional loop lookup calls are counted semantically. No gust/dispersion/micro/flash in this fixed pose.

If a nonpositive step occurs, this diagnostic records an invalid result and stops that ray instead of spinning to8192 as WGSL would; positiveSteps must pass. Finite grid samples exact centres of selected output pixels, not every2560x1440 fragment. Counts cannot be multiplied into GPU time/FPS. Continuous prism/certificate counts are opportunity diagnostics, not an implemented optimizer or GPU proof.
cacheSpecificLimits: Half conversion RNE explicitly modelled; GPU writes/uploads not executed. CPU ideal trilinear weights, output rounded f32; native filtering precision unqualified.
Cache node world positions use JS coordinate construction rounded f32; no WGSL FMA/reassociation equivalence.
A/s reconstruction is a changed material model; positive A can interpolate into originally A0 regions. s is retained at every A0 node.
All data from historical cached256/128/16 CPU input, not native GPU flow readback. No new cloud generation or real-time cache rebuild cost measurement.
Rain factorization changes floating point grouping before reconstruction; maximum sigma residual separately measured.
Boundary probes are bounded finite cap/domain checks at this fixed state; not a sweep of all growth/wind/amount/time or a continuous support proof.
